questions.question: Which storage account name is valid?
questions.explanation: Names are 3–24 lowercase letters and numbers.

questions.question: Which storage account type is recommended for most scenarios?
questions.explanation: Standard GPv2 supports all core services and redundancy options.

questions.question: Why must a storage account name be globally unique?

options.text: It becomes part of the service URL
It is required by Azure Policy

questions.explanation: Each account has endpoints such as name.blob.core.windows.net.
